economy.summary: His campaign says he established a First-Time Homebuyer Tax Rebate and is working to reduce energy costs for Pennsylvanians.
economy.short: Cites first-time homebuyer tax rebate; works to reduce energy costs.

abortion.summary: His campaign website describes him as a pro-choice candidate.
abortion.short: Campaign website describes him as pro-choice.

education.summary: His campaign describes him as pro-public education, saying he secured $16 million in new funding for the district's four school districts and advanced legislation providing free lunches for all Pennsylvania students.
education.short: Supports public education; advanced universal free school lunch legislation.

healthcare.summary: His campaign says he is focused on protecting access to healthcare and making it more affordable in Pennsylvania.
healthcare.short: Says he works to protect healthcare access and affordability.

energy.summary: Authored House Bill 2264, passed by the state House in June 2026, creating a voluntary Virtual Power Plant program that connects household technologies like smart thermostats, solar batteries, and electric vehicles to reduce peak demand; he called it a bill about practical solutions, affordability, and modernizing infrastructure.
energy.short: Authored Virtual Power Plant bill; cites affordability, grid modernization.

guns.summary: Authored House Bill 1909, passed by the state House in February 2026, increasing penalties for violating Protection from Abuse orders, saying current law lets repeat offenders keep contacting and harassing victims with minimal consequences. The bill addresses domestic-violence protective orders, not firearms policy.
guns.short: Authored bill raising penalties for Protection from Abuse violations.

economy.summary: In her 2024 Ballotpedia survey for this seat, she said she would promote policies that stimulate growth and said Pennsylvania can attract more businesses by streamlining the regulatory process and cutting red tape.
economy.short: Proposes stimulating growth; streamlining regulations to attract businesses.

taxes.summary: In her 2024 Ballotpedia survey for this seat, she said taxes can be lowered by reallocating taxpayer dollars to effective programs and reducing unnecessary spending.
taxes.short: Proposes lowering taxes by cutting unnecessary spending, reallocating dollars.

education.summary: In her 2024 Ballotpedia survey for this seat, she said she would prioritize strong reading programs as the foundation of learning, advocate for better resources and support for teachers, and emphasize hands-on learning in the curriculum.
education.short: Proposes strong reading programs, teacher support, hands-on learning.
